I am an old woman farming alone here in Salima, and this maize plot is what feeds my family. If the FISP coupon reaches me this year I will use the fertilizer, but as a widow with no schooling the coupons do not always come to me, so I must plan carefully and stretch whatever little I get across my plot. I will plant some local seed I saved, mix in pigeon pea between the maize rows as I always do, and do the weeding myself with my hoe since hiring ganyu costs money I do not have. I will put the small manure from my few chickens and goats near the planting stations to help the soil.
